traits.zh: 临水单层建筑，一侧为大面积玻璃幕墙与开放式吧台入口
traits.en: Single-story building facing water with large glass facade and open bar entrance

traits.zh: 对岸有树木、步道与户外桌椅区，水面平静
traits.en: Opposite bank features trees, pathways, and outdoor seating by calm water

traits.zh: 招牌饮品为桂花拿铁，融合中国茶文化
traits.en: Signature drink is osmanthus latte, blending Chinese tea culture

traits.zh: 提供手工焦糖南瓜重芝士蛋糕等西式甜点
traits.en: Offers handmade caramel pumpkin cheesecake and Western pastries

traits.zh: 营业时间覆盖早咖至晚间微醺，全天候运营
traits.en: Operates all day from morning coffee to evening drinks

focus.zh: 营业时间长但非专注空间
focus.en: Long hours but not focused space

adventure.zh: 使用碧螺春、龙井等茶咖实验
